research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Tigris Data is focused on developing methods for efficient storage and retrieval of small objects in distributed systems. Their research involves a computer-implemented method that optimizes the storage process by inlining objects in metadata storage and coalescing them for storage in an object store. This approach enhances the efficiency of object storage systems, aligning with Tigris's focus on globally distributed, S3-compatible object storage solutions.

Use all the familiar tools you love, mix and match any compute provider, and stay free from Big Cloud lock-in.

identifier.value: Tigris Globally Distributed S3-Compatible Object Storage

product.name: Tigris Globally Distributed S3-Compatible Object Storage
product.description: A multi-region object storage service compatible with AWS S3 API, providing global data availability and zero egress fees.

product.name: Shadow Bucket Migration
product.description: A migration feature that enables incremental, on-demand data copying from existing cloud storage to Tigris with read-through and write-through capabilities.

product.name: Docker Hub Pull-Through Cache
product.description: A caching service that stores Docker images pulled from Docker Hub in Tigris to reduce rate limit impacts and improve image pull performance.

identifier.value: Shadow Buckets for Global Image Delivery and Thumbnailing

product.name: Shadow Buckets for Global Image Delivery and Thumbnailing
product.description: A feature that fetches and caches files from another S3-compatible source on demand, enabling global thumbnail generation and delivery with caching.

identifier.value: FoundationDB Backup and Disaster Recovery Integration

product.name: FoundationDB Backup and Disaster Recovery Integration
product.description: Support for backing up and restoring FoundationDB databases using Tigris as the object storage backend for continuous and logical backups.
